new_server_rows.ask_user_question: Cloudflare의 web-perf skill을 그대로 유지할까요, 아니면 승인된 원본 업데이트/개별 skill 보완 경로로 바꿀까요? 그대로 두면 미등록 chrome-devtools 호출·설치 안내가 남고 현재 trace/Core Web Vitals/a11y 측정은 사용할 수 없습니다. 보완하면 정적 분석·기존 보고서 경로는 쓸 수 있지만 별도 승인된 측정 도구 없이 실측 기능은 얻지 못합니다. 이 결정은 Cloudflare의 다른 skill과 서버를 끄는 결정이 아닙니다.
new_server_rows.proposed_action: Report unresolved dependency; do not call absent APIs, install MCP, edit/delete cache or disable the whole Cloudflare plugin. Seek a separate user decision about upstream or narrowly scoped remediation.

exceptions.reason: External active plugin dependency needs a user decision; authorization to edit the upstream source is not established. Not KEEP and not a scan exclusion.

exclusions_policy: Preserve all original plan exclusions, including inactive trash/archive, old plugin cache, Squid and denylist. Active plugin skills are scanned read-only, not silently excluded.
coverage_limits: Explicit mcp__server__tool matches do not establish coverage of every prose dependency.
Bare-tool detection covers the six named Chrome DevTools APIs and chrome-devtools/Chrome DevTools MCP mentions; other unnamed tools, aliases or languages need manual review.
Conditional classification is restricted to the reviewed repo-owned web-perf document and its full safety gate; it is not permission to call a tool.
ASK_USER is an unresolved dependency exception, not proof that the plugin is safe or operational.
Registration names do not prove exposure, credentials, connection health or successful measurements. No MCP/API measurements are executed.
